usedFor: Olostep reads public web pages, with “Scrape Website” fetching content and “Generate AI Answer” searching the web for a reply.

bestTemplate.name: “Scrape Website” in Olostep
bestTemplate.why: It fetches a public page and extracts its content into formats such as Markdown.

watchOut: “Batch URL Scraper” takes a large list of URLs in one run, so check the list first.
